images.subject: A sleek far-future spacecraft engine shaped like one single smooth streamlined armoured capsule, with no pipes and no exposed machinery, mounted horizontally on a test stand.
images.detail: A long roaring flame shoots out of a compact ring-shaped exhaust port set flush into the end of the capsule, and thin illuminated light strips run along its casing.

images.subject: A sleek far-future high-tech chemical rocket engine, centred in the frame and filling most of it, with a seamless armoured casing, illuminated light strips and one short bell nozzle of polished white ceramic glowing with heat bands, mounted horizontally on a compact test stand.
images.detail: A long roaring orange flame with bright shock diamonds shoots out of it and exits the frame on the right.

images.subject: A sleek far-future high-tech rocket engine block, centred in the frame and filling most of it, with a seamless armoured casing and illuminated light strips, ending in a tight cluster of three compact glowing nozzles, mounted horizontally on a compact test stand.
images.detail: A long roaring orange flame with bright shock diamonds shoots out of it and exits the frame on the right.

images.subject: A sleek far-future high-tech combustion engine, centred in the frame and filling most of it, with a seamless armoured casing whose open side ports reveal the blazing combustion chamber inside, mounted horizontally on a compact test stand.
images.detail: A long roaring orange flame with bright shock diamonds shoots out of it and exits the frame on the right.

images.subject: A sleek far-future high-tech aerospike rocket engine, centred in the frame and filling most of it, with a seamless armoured casing and illuminated light strips, its exhaust ring wrapped around one central tapered metal spike, mounted horizontally on a compact test stand.
images.detail: A long roaring orange flame with bright shock diamonds shoots out of it and exits the frame on the right.
